title: Elden Ring
blurb: FromSoftware's open-world epic. Ride across the Lands Between, die to Margit, and love every minute of it.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
blurb: Larian's Dungeons & Dragons masterpiece. Every bad decision is fully voice-acted and fully your fault.

title: Hades
blurb: Escape the Underworld again and again. Dying has never felt this good, or been this well-written.

title: Stardew Valley
blurb: Inherit a farm, marry a goth doctor, and forget what sunlight looks like. Made by one person.

title: Hollow Knight
blurb: A hand-drawn descent into a ruined insect kingdom. Cheap, enormous, and quietly devastating.

title: Portal 2
blurb: Valve's perfect puzzle box. GLaDOS insults you, Wheatley disappoints you, co-op tests friendships.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
blurb: Geralt hunts monsters and fumbles fatherhood across a war-torn continent. Bring tissues and horse snacks.

title: Celeste
blurb: A pixel-precise platformer about anxiety that will make you cry and swear in equal measure.

title: God of War
blurb: Kratos tries gentle parenting in Norse mythology. The Leviathan Axe throw never gets old.

title: Red Dead Redemption 2
blurb: An outlaw elegy with the best horse physics ever committed to code. Slow, sad, and stunning.

title: Disco Elysium
blurb: You are the world's worst detective with the world's best inner monologue. Argue with your own necktie.

title: Outer Wilds
blurb: A 22-minute time loop across a dying solar system. Go in blind. Trust us on this one.

title: Vampire Survivors
blurb: Move one stick, become an unstoppable garlic-powered death god. The best value in gaming history.

title: Slay the Spire
blurb: The deckbuilder that launched a thousand clones. Still the one to beat, one card at a time.

title: Terraria
blurb: Dig, build, and fight the Wall of Flesh. A decade of free updates and still going.

title: Deep Rock Galactic
blurb: Dwarves mine, bugs swarm, nobody gets left behind. The friendliest co-op shooter ever made.

title: Persona 5 Royal
blurb: Steal corrupt hearts by day, ace exams by night. Every menu looks better than most games.

title: Street Fighter 6
blurb: The best onboarding a fighting game ever had, plus a battle hub that eats weekends.

title: Tekken 8
blurb: Aggressive, gorgeous, and gloriously dramatic. Your dad's fighting game, perfected.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
blurb: Rough launch, remarkable recovery. Night City is now one of gaming's great places to get lost.

title: Dave the Diver
tag: Dive by day, sushi by night.
blurb: Harpoon fish, run a sushi bar, befriend dolphins. Absurdly charming and impossible to put down.

title: Balatro
blurb: A poker roguelike made by one developer that broke every sales chart. You will dream in jokers.

title: It Takes Two
blurb: A co-op fairy tale about divorce that is somehow joyful. Every level invents a new game.

title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
blurb: Parry or perish in Sengoku Japan. The combat system so good it ruined other action games.

title: Doom Eternal
tag: Rip and tear, now with ammo math.
blurb: A first-person chess match played at 200 BPM with a shotgun. Mick Gordon goes unbelievably hard.

title: Half-Life: Alyx
blurb: Valve remembered how to make Half-Life and put it inside your face. Still the VR benchmark.

title: Factorio
blurb: Build conveyor belts until 4 AM and call it engineering. Crack cocaine for optimizers.

title: RimWorld
tag: Your colonists will eat each other.
blurb: A sci-fi colony sim where every playthrough becomes a war-crime anecdote you tell at parties.

title: Dead Cells
blurb: A headless hero sprints through a shifting castle. Combat so smooth it feels unfair to other games.

title: Monster Hunter Rise
blurb: Ride a dog, wirebug onto a dragon's face, carve it into pants. Peak multiplayer loop.
